high_level_description: A product photo of a minimalist steel wristwatch with a black dial lying on dark slate, dramatic side lighting.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Dark textured slate surface filling the frame, black background fading out at the top.

elements.desc: Brushed stainless steel wristwatch with a matte black dial, thin silver hands and a black leather strap, lying at a slight angle.
Small white sans-serif brand name printed on the dial below the twelve o'clock marker, uppercase, regular, upright, tiny.
